tidbit: Did you know… about 12,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
NetEase LobsterAI will refund DeepSeek users' consumption points within 7 working days following a service outage, as reported by 凤凰网科技.
DeepSeek quietly launched a new model version V4.1 Flash-1017 with pricing at 5 yuan per 1000 searches, but deleted it seconds later, still open per 驱动之家.
Anthropic is pitching a bill that would let the US block artificial intelligence models only if they risk over 1 billion dollars in damage, 50 deaths or serious injuries, reported by TradingView.
ChatGPT ranks user intelligence in the 80th through 95th percentile with vague assessments, while competitors decline to rank humans, reported by The Cool Down.
Anthropic tested artificial intelligence model distribution on Android devices, noting setup times and security limits in smart home environments, reported by NeoTeo.
Free every hour.
